NOW, THERETORE, I, RAMON MACSAYSAY, President of the Philip-
pines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby or'er:
1. That the business of manufacturine, distributing and sell-
ine Premix Rice now being undertaken by the National Rice and Corn
Corporation shall be transferred and entmisted to private enterprises.
/
2. That the NAPIC Premix Plant facilities shall he leased im-
mediately by the National Rice and Corn Corporation under reasonahle
terms not later than Movem'er 30, 1954, to a competent private party
who, in the opinion of the Secretary of Health, can satisfactorily

mentation of the law, and who will cooperate with the Department'
of Health in the promotion of Rice Enrichment in the Philippines.
3. That dollar allocation for the importation of the vitamins
and chemicals needed for the manufacture of the Premix' Rice shall
he set aside yearly in such amounts as may he required, and assigned
to bona-fide manufacturers of Premix Rice as certified by the Sec-
retary of Health, to be used exclusively by said manufacturers for
the manufacture of Premix Rice only.
4. That the amount, of P100, 000 shall be immediately released
from the balance of the appropriation in Republic Act No. 832 to
the Institute of Nutrition, Department of Health, to be used for
the purchase, , transportation, sales and installation of approved
feeders as facility required by Republic Act No.
implementation.
5. That the National Shipyards and Steel Corporation shall
manufacture and deliver the tie of feeders as approved by the

6. That the Denartment of Health shall encourare the man-
facture and sale of approved feeders by private firms, provided
that, the prices are comnetitive with those of the National. Ship-
yards and Steel.
Corporation.
7. That the Department, of Health and its agencies shall
undertake the distribution and sale of approved feeders to each
and every rice miller in the Philippines at actual cost under

such a system as to allow rice millers to readily procure and

9. That each rice miller shall, on his account and respon-
sihility, procure and install the feeder in his rice mill not
later than thirty (30) days before the date of effectivity of
the law in the locality where his rice mill is erected.
9. That the Department of Health is hereby empowered to
issue such orders, males and regulations as are necessary to
imnlement this Order and to control. and supervise the price and
cuality of the Premix Rice manufactured and distributed by the
private firms.
10. That the balance of the original appropriation of
1300,000 in Repuhlic Act No. 832 shall be immediately released
for the implementation of this Order.
11. That the Decartment of Health shall encourare competi-
tion in the production and distrihution of Premix Rice, provided
that such competition will not adversely affect the wiversal an-
plication of the Act.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th daw of Aumist, in the
year of Our lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-four, and of the
Independence of the Philippines, the ninth.
(Sea.) RAMON MAGSAYSAY
